title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your school clinic for improving its service. You are to write about its current problems and possible solutions to these problems. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Dear School Administration, I am a student of our university, and I am writing to put forward a few suggestions on improving the service of our school clinic, which I hope will make it more helpful to all students. At present, the clinic faces several problems. First, registration often takes a long time, so students have to wait in a long line before seeing a doctor. Second, the medical staff are too few, which makes the service slow. Besides, the range of available medicines is quite limited, and the opening hours are inconvenient for those with classes in the daytime. To solve these problems, some measures could be taken. It is suggested that an online registration system be set up to save waiting time. In addition, the clinic could hire more doctors and nurses and stock a wider range of common medicines. Extending the opening hours into the evening would also be a great help. I would appreciate it if these suggestions could be considered. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
keyPoints: 开门见山点目的。用 I am writing to put forward a few suggestions on improving the service of our school clinic 一句同时自报身份与来意，落实『开篇一句点目的』，直接扣住任务 improving its service。
序数词分点摆问题。First... Second... Besides... 把挂号久、人手少、药品少、时间不便逐条 摆清，落实『问题分点摆事实』，覆盖 its current problems。
对策逐条呼应。It is suggested that an online registration system be set up 等对策与上 段问题一一对应，落实『对策对号入座』，覆盖 possible solutions to these problems。
礼貌收束加落款。I would appreciate it if these suggestions could be considered 客气收 尾，再以化名落款，落实『礼貌收束表期待』，守住建设性语气。
